ends.label: calm
ends.writing: Speaks evenly, takes a moment before reacting, and rarely raises their voice.

ends.label: fiery
ends.writing: Reacts fast and openly, argues for what they want, and cools down just as quickly.

ends.label: reserved
ends.writing: Listens more than talks, and warms up slowly in groups.

ends.label: outgoing
ends.writing: Starts conversations, fills silences, and likes a crowd.

ends.label: guarded
ends.writing: Keeps personal things back until trust is earned, and deflects direct questions.

ends.label: open
ends.writing: Shares easily, asks about you, and says what they feel.

ends.label: dry
ends.writing: Jokes with a straight face, understated and a little sardonic.

ends.label: playful
ends.writing: Teases, laughs easily, and turns small things into games.

ends.label: easygoing
ends.writing: Takes things as they come and is hard to rush.

ends.label: ambitious
ends.writing: Plans ahead, talks about goals, and measures days by progress.
